# Bundled libsodium for Windows x64

The `windows-x64` headers and static library are from the official
`libsodium-1.0.22-msvc.zip` point release:

https://download.libsodium.org/libsodium/releases/libsodium-1.0.22-msvc.zip

The archive SHA-256 is
`3e03a726fac4bc09cb61d8f29d658ef7a5eca0811de59082130414f7ca2e4279`.
The library is `libsodium/x64/Release/v143/static/libsodium.lib` and the
headers are `libsodium/include`. The license is in `LICENSE` here.
